overview: Black offers a second pawn idea after 2.dxe5: 2...d6 hits the e5 pawn so that exd6 Bxd6 gives open lines and quick development. White can keep a pawn by 3.Nf3 dxe5 4.Nxe5 or 3.exd6 Bxd6 4.Nf3 Nf6. Black scores through activity and traps but gets little compensation against good play.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn by capturing and developing calmly: exd6 Bxd6 and Nf3, Nc3.
Neutralise Black's lead in development and trade queens.

black_ideas.idea: Develop rapidly with ...Bxd6, ...Nf6, ...Nc6 and use open lines for the pawn.
Set traps against the queen and king on the d-file or Bg4 ideas.

typical_structures.structure: Open position with White a pawn up and Black developed on the e/d files.

character.notes: Black gambit with rapid development, tactical traps and open lines.

gambit.notes: White can keep the pawn with accurate play.

structure.notes: Central pawns exchanged with open lines.

approach.notes: Strong players almost never choose it.

level.notes: Dubious gambit, so not for beginners; needs trap knowledge.

character.reason: A gambit with open lines and traps where one slip loses fast.

soundness.reason: White keeps an extra pawn against correct play.
